mentions.name: Scandle
mentions.description: A very casual daily price-guessing game where players guess prices once a day. Built as a way to de-rust CSS and React skills and learn how daily games work, iterating on daily feedback.
mentions.audience: The author's mum, who plays daily and gives feedback
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a very casual daily price-guessing game for my mum. Every day she gives me feedback, and I'm using it as a chance to de-rust my CSS/React + see how daily games tick.
